diagnostics.message: op.drop_column in upgrade() removes or renames a column or a table that the running version still reads until the new one replaces it, and a drop deletes its data. Add the new column or table first, and drop or rename the old one in a later migration, with a suppression that gives the reason: no running code reads it any more, or the program is stopped while it migrates.
